sections.heading: Forming the passive
sections.body:
In the **passive**, the object of the action becomes the subject: *Le chat mange la souris* → *La souris **est mangée** par le chat.* (The mouse is eaten by the cat.)

Passive = *être* (in the needed tense) + past participle, which **agrees** with the subject:

The agent ("by…") is introduced by *par*: *Ce tableau a été peint **par** Monet.* With verbs of feeling or description, *de* is common: *Elle est aimée **de** tous.* *La table est couverte **de** livres.*

head: Tense
Example
rows: *La maison **est construite** en 2025.* — The house is being built…
*La maison **a été construite** en 1900.* — The house was built in 1900.
*Le pont **était fermé**.* — The bridge was closed.
*Les résultats **seront publiés** demain.* — The results will be published tomorrow.
*La lettre **avait été envoyée**.* — The letter had been sent.

sections.heading: When to use it
sections.body: The passive is common in news, formal writing and descriptions, to focus on what happened rather than who did it: *Deux personnes ont été blessées.* (Two people were injured.) *Le musée a été rénové.* *La réunion est annulée.*

sections.heading: Avoiding the passive
sections.body:
In everyday French, the passive is less used than in English. Two common alternatives:

- ***on*** + active verb: *On a volé ma voiture.* (My car has been stolen.) *On parle français ici.* (French is spoken here.)
- a **pronominal verb**: *Ce vin **se boit** frais.* (This wine is drunk cool.) *Ça **se dit** comment en français ?* (How is that said in French?) *Les billets **se vendent** en ligne.*

Only verbs with a direct object can become passive: ~~*Il a été téléphoné*~~ is impossible — say *On lui a téléphoné.*

examples: La maison a été construite en 1900.
The house was built in 1900.
Ce tableau a été peint par Monet.
This painting was painted by Monet.
Les résultats seront publiés demain.
The results will be published tomorrow.
Deux personnes ont été blessées dans l'accident.
Two people were injured in the accident.
Le musée a été rénové l'année dernière.
The museum was renovated last year.
La réunion est annulée.
The meeting is cancelled.
Ce livre a été écrit par une jeune autrice.
This book was written by a young author.
La table est couverte de papiers.
The table is covered with papers.
Elle est aimée de tous ses élèves.
She's loved by all her pupils.
On a volé ma voiture cette nuit.
My car was stolen last night.
On parle français et anglais ici.
French and English are spoken here.
Ça se dit comment en français ?
How do you say that in French?
Ce vin se boit frais.
This wine is drunk cool.
